q: Who is the founder of Cyber Savvy Pro?
a: Cyber Savvy Pro was founded by Sam Maina, a seasoned software engineer and technology architect based along Mombasa Road, Nairobi, Kenya. Sam actively oversees every client engagement and technical roadmap.

q: Do you build custom software or just use templates?
a: We engineer 100% bespoke software, custom ERP systems, and web applications tailored specifically to your exact business rules, data structures, and branding. We do not sell generic off-the-shelf templates.

q: How do your monthly retainers work?
a: Our retainers provide you with dedicated full-stack engineering hours, ongoing SEO optimization, and 24/7 IT infrastructure management with guaranteed SLAs and direct communication channels.

q: Can you integrate local payment methods like M-Pesa alongside international cards?
a: Yes! We specialize in seamless payment gateway architectures, connecting Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja APIs (STK Push, C2B, B2C), card processors like Stripe and Flutterwave, and PayPal in a unified checkout flow.

q: Do I own 100% of the code and intellectual property?
a: Absolutely. Upon milestone completion and final invoice settlement, full source code repositories, intellectual property, database schemas, and documentation are transferred to your company.

q: How do we get started on a new project?
a: You can request a free technical consultation via our Contact page or call Sam Maina directly at +254 722 359 298. We will organize a scoping workshop to outline requirements and deliver a formal proposal within 48 hours.

q: What actually happens in the free scoping call?
a: You talk directly with founder Sam Maina about your operational problem. Within 30 minutes you'll have a rough technical direction, an honest budget range, and a clear next step — or a straight answer that you don't need custom software at all.

q: Will you disrupt our operations during the build?
a: No. New systems are built and tested on a separate staging environment. Your current spreadsheets and processes keep running until the new system is validated, your data is migrated and your team is trained — then we cut over.

q: Can you migrate our existing data?
a: Yes. Data migration off spreadsheets and legacy systems is a standard part of every build — cleaned, deduplicated and validated before launch so nothing is lost or mispriced in the move.
